title: A 403 without the role reason, every 409, and every 422 became a terminal refusal whatever the body said, so the composer dropped the key on an answer that established no refusal
resolution: refusalOf reads a 403, 409, or 422 by its documented reason (role-required, idempotency-key-reused, session-stopped); any other body reads as unavailable, so the key stays for a retry; tests for each status without, with another, and with no JSON reason.

title: An unavailable or throwing session read after a CSRF refusal still consumed the one re-read and sent the key again with the unchanged token, so a second refusal dropped the record without a renewed token
resolution: Session.refresh answers the SessionRead; the key is sent again only after an authenticated read, an unavailable one keeps the record as token-not-renewed with a retry; page tests with a fake and with the real gateways over a scripted control plane checking the token header of each request.

title: The over-limit error of the Textarea drew Mantine's error color, 3.28:1 in the light scheme and 3.44:1 in the dark one, which the contrast matrix did not test, against the design's no-new-color-pair claim
resolution: The theme's cssVariablesResolver sets --mantine-color-error to red.9 (light) and red.5 (dark); theme-contrast.test.ts measures the error text on the page and in an input in both schemes through the resolver, and the design names the pair.

title: After any storage throw the in-memory flag kept clearAll from the storage, so text written before a quota failure survived a sign-out and reappeared after a reload
resolution: clearAll tries the storage whatever threw before and falls back to memory only when the removal itself throws; test with a write, a failing write, clearAll, and a fresh store over the same storage.

title: The record names, the live session key, and the composer's React key joined the raw identifiers with a slash, so a/b + c and a + b/c shared records, state, and feed identity
resolution: sessionAddress encodes each identifier with encodeURIComponent before joining; the record names, useLiveSession, and SessionPage use it; collision tests in the store and on the page.

title: showTurn dereferenced the current feed, so a submission of session A answered after a move to session B amended B's timeline
resolution: showTurn is bound to the feed of its session address and load and ignores a feed of another; the record still settles; page test with a deferred answer resolved after the move.

title: Retry buttons stayed active under every composer block and the hook had no in-flight guard, so two records could be sent at once against the one-send-at-a-time rule
resolution: Retry buttons are disabled under every block; the hook holds a synchronous in-flight flag that drops a send or retry while a record is being sent; page tests per block and a hook test for the same tick.

title: Each manual retry started a new delivery chain with the re-read allowance reset, so a key could read the session again after CSRF, refresh, failure, retry, CSRF; a reload reset it too
resolution: The spent re-read is the record's tokenRefreshed, set after a read that renewed the token and kept in sessionStorage, so it survives failures, retries, and a reload; tests for the sequence, for two keys, and for a restored spent record.

title: The automatic resend after a session read ran whatever the read showed, also after another sign-in, a sign-out, or the composer's unmount, so a message could go out under a replacement session
resolution: Session.signedInGeneration numbers each sign-in; the hook captures it at send and resends only from a mounted composer under the same generation after an authenticated read, else keeps the record as session-changed; deferred-read tests for another operator, a move away, and a sign-out.

title: A resync read whose snapshot predated the submission dropped the turn showTurn had amended in when it resolved, while the record was already removed
resolution: The live feed keeps the amendments made during a read with the stream changes and applies them over the snapshot; feed test with a resync read held across showTurn.

title: The 401 recovery stayed a recorded departure: Q4's record clearing abandoned Q3's same-key retry after sign-in without a coordinator decision
resolution: Coordinator decision (Niki, 2026-11-04): Q4 wins for a 401, Q3's retry applies only to a late 401 that did not end the session, and the sign-in page says the last turn may not have been sent when a sign-out dropped an unconfirmed record; tests, design decision 5, and a spec scenario.

title: retry passed the shown submission into deliver, so on the next CSRF refusal spend wrote its state into sessionStorage and merged the stale state back, unblocking the composer while the resend was in flight
resolution: retry sends the submission's plain TurnRecord (recordOf of composer-model), and spend merges only tokenRefreshed into the shown submission; page test holds the renewed session read and then the resend and checks the Sending notice, the disabled field, no Retry, and the stored record's keys.

title: An anonymous session read after a CSRF refusal answered undefined, so the submission stayed pending and the composer blocked when the shell left it mounted
resolution: answerOf settles an anonymous read as session-changed, like another sign-in or an unmount; hook test under the providers with a read that finds no session.

title: Records dropped under a signed-out view with notice none gave no may-not-have-been-sent line, and a second clearAll under StrictMode reset dropped to false
resolution: SignInPage's first-visit text adds the note too; the provider accumulates the drop while signed out (setDropped((was) => was || store.clearAll())) and forgets it on the next sign-in; page tests for a visit without a session, a later clean sign-out, and a StrictMode mount under a signed-out view.

title: The scenario Sign-in changes during the session read said the key is kept for a signed-out shell, while decision 5 drops every record on sign-out
resolution: The scenario names no session among the reads and keeps the key unless the shell is signed out, which drops the records of every session.

title: verification.md counted five new test files where there are six, and proposal.md omitted signedInGeneration and the record's tokenRefreshed
resolution: The self-check names the six test files; the proposal names signedInGeneration on the Session context and tokenRefreshed in the record.

title: JSON.stringify of the console arguments did not inspect an Error's non-enumerable message or stack, so a token logged inside an Error passed the wiring test
resolution: The wiring test maps each console argument through its stack or message when it is an Error before the search; fb-31b-p2-6.log shows a mutation logging the token inside an Error passing the old assertion and failing the new one.

title: After Send the disabled button lost the keyboard focus to body, and nothing returned it when the answer arrived
resolution: The composer remembers a send or retry from its own buttons and focuses the field once sending ends and no block holds; page tests after a held send and after a retry of a restored record.
